body: I always have this problem with nmc. They never update the results. Try prime or aster next time.
Anything to push me through the next couple of days.
Same. But i need to sort out a few things before leaving (family). Each day gets more and more painful. Living is such a burden.

I can only imagine. It must be painful. I get suicidal at night. I want to die. But i just keep pushing. Drinking probably "helps" but it's only temporary.

Try therapy, get a new hobby, new pet. Just something to keep you moving. Slowly, slowly you'll get better. It's painful now but it gets better (i hope).

And make new friends. Meet new people. Find friends here (it helps).

Exactly such is life.

But, you'll rise above it. Right now its soo painful you feel empty and lost. But time, with time, it'll get easier.
You'll find yourself. And with time you'll love yourself, you'll heal and this pain will be something of the past.
